success_definition: block CoG < 20 px AND |angle| < 20 deg, checked after every step (primary)
pos_success_definition: block CoG < 20 px after any step; on pairs whose start CoG error >= 20 px
tag_definition: from the final state: success | position_only (CoG < 20 px, angle >= 20 deg) | angle_only | both_failed; believed = CEM terminal cost < tau (own encoder) at some step

wm.definition: pct of ||E_wm(o_i) - E_wm(o_j)||^2 over same-val-episode frame pairs with is_success(s_i, s_j); imagined success = terminal ||z_H - z_g||^2 < tau

wm_1step.definition: pct of ||E_wm(o_i) - E_wm(o_j)||^2 over same-val-episode frame pairs with is_success(s_i, s_j); imagined success = terminal ||z_H - z_g||^2 < tau
